title: Fullstack AI & Automation Engineer
description:
**100% remote \| 1099 contract position \| 25–30 hours per week \| united states only**

**hourly rate: $25\.00–$32\.00 per hour**

*(based on experience, technical ability, and relevant gohighlevel experience)*

**build ai systems that help real businesses grow**

are you passionate about building intelligent software instead of repetitive websites?

do you enjoy solving complex technical challenges using ai, automation, apis, and modern software development tools?

automation agency is looking for a talented **full stack engineer** to help build next\-generation ai\-powered business systems for clients across the united states.

this isn't a traditional web development position.

you'll help design and build ai receptionists, ai sales representatives, voice ai agents, crm solutions, custom saas applications, api integrations, and advanced automation systems that help businesses become more efficient and profitable.

this position begins as a **part\-time 1099 contract position (25–35 hours per week)** with the opportunity for high\-performing contractors to transition into a **full\-time position** as our company continues to grow.

if you're excited about artificial intelligence, automation, and solving real\-world business problems, we'd love to meet you.

**about automation agency**

automation agency is a u.s.\-based ai automation company specializing in designing and deploying intelligent business solutions for companies throughout the united states.

we partner directly with business owners to eliminate repetitive processes, automate operations, improve customer experiences, and build ai\-powered systems that generate measurable business results.

our team builds technology that businesses depend on every day.

we care about **results, ownership, problem\-solving, and the ability to deliver**.

you don't need to follow a traditional career path to succeed here.

**we care more about what you can build than where you learned to build it.**

a formal degree is not required. demonstrated technical ability, real\-world experience, strong problem\-solving skills, and a portfolio of work are highly valued.

**what you'll build**

as a full stack engineer, you'll help design, develop, and support solutions including:

* agentic ai systems
* voice ai agents
* ai receptionists
* ai sales representatives
* ai chatbots
* advanced gohighlevel crm solutions
* custom saas applications
* rest apis
* business process automation
* internal operational software
* ai\-powered workflows
* crm integrations
* intelligent dashboards
* custom ai integrations

every project you work on will solve real business challenges for companies throughout the united states.

**what you'll be doing**

your work may include:

* building ai\-powered automation systems
* developing custom node.js backend services
* creating react or next.js applications
* building advanced gohighlevel automations and crm solutions
* integrating ai models and ai apis
* developing third\-party api integrations
* designing webhook\-based automation workflows
* troubleshooting production systems
* participating in technical discussions with u.s.\-based clients
* understanding business requirements and translating them into technical solutions
* collaborating with our founders and engineering team
* researching and learning new technologies when a project requires them
* taking ownership of projects from development through completion

no two weeks are the same.

you'll work on a wide variety of challenging technical projects where your ability to **think, troubleshoot, learn, and deliver** will matter more than simply following instructions.

**why you'll enjoy working with us**

* 100% remote
* part\-time 1099 contract position
* 25–30 hours per week
* competitive hourly compensation
* opportunity to transition into a full\-time position
* work with cutting\-edge ai technologies
* build real software that businesses use every day
* collaborate directly with company founders
* variety of challenging technical projects
* small, highly collaborative engineering team
* opportunity for professional growth as the company expands
* opportunity to work across ai, automation, crm, saas, and full\-stack development

**technologies you'll work with**

our technology stack continues to evolve as ai and automation technology changes.

**frontend**

* react
* next.js
* javascript
* html/css

**backend**

* node.js
* express.js
* rest apis
* webhooks

**databases**

* mongodb
* postgresql

**ai \& automation**

* gohighlevel
* openai
* anthropic
* mcp servers
* make.com
* zapier
* n8n

**development tools**

* git
* github
* docker
* ci/cd

we actively encourage our engineers to leverage ai tools to improve productivity, solve problems, research unfamiliar technologies, and deliver exceptional solutions.

you are **not expected to already be an expert in every technology listed above**.

what matters most is that you have strong fundamentals, can learn quickly, and can independently figure out how to solve problems.

**what you must bring**

we're looking for someone who can demonstrate strong ability in the following areas:

* **hands\-on gohighlevel experience**
* professional software development experience with demonstrated full\-stack capabilities
* strong javascript and node.js development skills
* experience building frontend applications using react, next.js, or similar technologies
* experience building and consuming rest apis
* experience integrating third\-party apis
* experience working with mongodb, postgresql, or similar databases
* experience building automation workflows using webhooks
* experience working with ai apis, llms, ai agents, or ai\-powered applications
* strong troubleshooting and debugging skills
* excellent written and verbal english communication skills
* ability to work independently without requiring constant step\-by\-step direction
* ability to collaborate effectively with a remote team
* strong sense of ownership and accountability
* demonstrated reliability and ability to follow through on commitments

**gohighlevel experience**

gohighlevel experience is an important part of this position.

you should have practical experience working inside gohighlevel and be comfortable building or troubleshooting systems involving areas such as:

* ai agents
* workflows
* pipelines
* automations
* custom values
* webhooks
* integrations
* calendars
* crm functionality
* subaccounts
* apis

**we are more interested in what you have actually built with gohighlevel than the number of years you have used it.**

candidates with deeper ghl experience will have an advantage.

**preferred qualifications**

experience with any of the following is a plus:

* gohighlevel api development
* twilio
* synthflow
* voice ai platforms
* ai agent development
* mcp
* langchain
* docker
* ci/cd pipelines
* mongodb
* postgresql
* make.com
* n8n
* zapier
* cursor ai
* github copilot
* monday.com

you do not need experience with everything listed above.

we value **strong technical fundamentals, curiosity, adaptability, and the ability to learn new technologies quickly.**

**what success looks like**

within your first 90 days, you'll be expected to:

* independently complete assigned ai, automation, and development projects.
* build and troubleshoot integrations between gohighlevel and third\-party platforms.
* develop reliable api and webhook\-based systems.
* contribute to ai\-powered applications and voice ai solutions.
* communicate proactively about project status, challenges, and deadlines.
* participate in client\-facing technical discussions when needed.
* take ownership of problems rather than waiting for step\-by\-step instructions.
* consistently deliver production\-ready work that meets project requirements.
* learn new technologies and tools when projects require them.
* demonstrate reliability, professionalism, and strong follow\-through.

the goal isn't simply to stay busy.

**the goal is to produce meaningful results.**

**client interaction**

our engineers do more than write code.

you'll regularly communicate with u.s.\-based business owners and team members to understand business requirements, recommend technical solutions, provide project updates, troubleshoot issues, and help deliver exceptional client experiences.

professionalism, communication, and technical expertise are equally important in this role.

you don't need to be a salesperson.

you do need to be able to communicate technical concepts clearly, ask good questions, listen carefully, and represent automation agency professionally.

**who we're looking for**

we're looking for professionals who:

* take ownership of their work
* follow through on commitments
* communicate proactively
* are honest and transparent when something goes wrong
* write clean, scalable, maintainable code
* enjoy solving challenging technical problems
* can troubleshoot instead of immediately waiting for someone else to provide the answer
* continuously learn new technologies
* demonstrate integrity and professionalism
* thrive in a collaborative remote environment
* enjoy working directly with clients
* can manage their time and priorities independently
* care about the quality and results of their work

**we're looking for people who want to grow with the company, not simply complete assigned tasks.**

**work schedule**

this is a **part\-time position averaging 25–30 hours per week.**

your work schedule will be established at the time of hire based on project needs and mutual agreement.

all scheduled hours will be worked between:

**7:00 am – 4:00 pm (phoenix, arizona time)**

monday through friday.

applicants must be able to consistently work their assigned schedule during these hours.

**contractor expectations**

this position is a **1099 contract position.**

contractors are responsible for providing their own:

* computer and development equipment
* high\-speed internet connection
* professional work environment
* backup internet connection (recommended)
* backup power solution (recommended)
* applicable taxes and contractor obligations

compensation is based on approved hours worked.

high\-performing contractors may be considered for future full\-time employment as business needs grow.

**work environment \& equipment**

applicants must have:

* a quiet, professional environment suitable for focused development work and client meetings
* reliable high\-speed internet
* a modern development computer capable of handling the required software and development tools
* a professional webcam and microphone for video meetings

a dedicated home office is **not required**, provided you have a professional environment suitable for the work.

**applicant requirements**

this position is open only to applicants who:

* currently reside within the united states
* are legally authorized to provide services as a 1099 independent contractor
* can consistently work within our required operating hours
* successfully complete a background check
* complete identity verification
* sign a non\-disclosure agreement and non\-solicitation agreement

because our engineers may have access to client systems, business data, credentials, and production environments, maintaining strong security and confidentiality is an essential part of the position.

we are not accepting applications from:

* offshore developers
* international contractors
* staffing agencies
* recruiting firms
* applicants requiring visa sponsorship

**video introduction**

as part of our hiring process, qualified applicants may be asked to submit a **2–3 minute video introduction**.

please be prepared to briefly discuss:

* your full stack development experience
* your gohighlevel experience
* an ai or automation project you're proud of
* a challenging technical problem you've solved
* why you're interested in joining automation agency

a video introduction may be requested during the screening process.

this gives us an opportunity to see how you communicate, explain technical concepts, and approach real\-world problems.

**portfolio \& demonstrated work**

we strongly encourage applicants to provide examples of work that demonstrate their technical ability.

include any of the following, if available:

* portfolio
* public applications
* ai automation examples
* voice ai demonstrations
* technical walkthrough videos
* screenshots of relevant projects
* gohighlevel examples
* api integration examples
* saas applications
* other software you've personally built
* github profile
* linkedin profile

**your portfolio doesn't need to be perfect or publicly available.**

if your work is confidential, you can explain the project, your role, the technology used, and the problem you solved without revealing confidential client information.

**technical evaluation**

candidates who advance in the hiring process may be asked to complete a practical technical evaluation.

our evaluation is designed to understand how you actually think and solve problems.

we may evaluate areas such as:

* full\-stack development
* api integrations
* webhooks
* gohighlevel
* ai integrations
* debugging
* system architecture
* problem\-solving
* technical communication

**we care about demonstrated ability more than credentials.**

**ready to build the future?**

if you're excited about building ai\-powered business systems, solving meaningful technical challenges, and working with a growing u.s. ai automation company, we'd love to hear from you.

if you're someone who takes ownership, learns quickly, communicates clearly, and wants to build technology that produces real business results, this could be an excellent opportunity to grow with automation agency.

**apply today and help us build the future of ai\-powered business automation.**

pay: $25\.00 \- $32\.00 per hour

expected hours: 20\.0 – 30\.0 per week

* how much hands\-on experience do you have building and managing systems in gohighlevel? answer: less than 1 year, 1\-2 years, 2\-3 years or 3\+ years?

title: AI Systems & Solutions Engineer
description:
at bwx technologies, inc. (nyse: bwxt), we are people strong, innovation driven. a u.s.\-based company, bwxt is a fortune 1000 and defense news top 100 manufacturing and engineering innovator that provides safe and effective nuclear solutions for global security, clean energy, environmental restoration, nuclear medicine and space exploration. with more than 7,800 employees, bwxt has 14 major operating sites in the u.s., canada and the u.k. we are the sole manufacturer of naval nuclear reactors for u.s. submarines and aircraft carriers. our company supplies precision manufactured components, services and fuel for the commercial nuclear power industry across four continents. our joint ventures provide environmental restoration and operations management at a dozen u.s. department of energy and nasa facilities. bwxt’s technology is driving advances in medical radioisotope production in north america and microreactors for various defense and space applications. for more information, visit www.bwxt.com. follow us on linkedin, x, facebook and instagram.

 **welcome to bwxt**  

we believe in empowering our employees and cultivating a dynamic workplace that fosters growth, collaboration, and technical excellence. at our oak ridge, tennessee enrichment operations site, you will join teams working at the forefront of advanced nuclear manufacturing, precision engineering, and mission‑critical national security programs. whether you're an experienced professional or just starting your career, you’ll find opportunities to challenge yourself, partner with seasoned experts, and contribute to innovation shaping the future of nuclear technology. our work requires a wide range of skills, and we welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds and career stages who share a passion for meaningful impact and technical advancement.


**position overview**  

as an ai systems \& solutions engineer, you will support enterprise\-level digital engineering, manufacturing modernization, and operations analytics initiatives across the oak ridge enrichment operations site. you will develop open\-source ai tools, maintain production ai stacks, and design ml\-driven solutions that support digital thread integration, operational optimization, and engineering decision\-making. this role interacts with engineering, manufacturing, operations, and automation teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and secure ai capabilities for high‑value missions.


**location**  

on\-site in oak ridge, tennessee


**your day to day as an ai systems \& solutions engineer**  

* architect and maintain open\-source ai/ml tools, including model training and inference pipelines.
* build and support full ai stacks using python, mlflow, tensorflow/pytorch, docker, git, and kubernetes.
* design ai/ml solutions for manufacturing optimization, engineering workflows, business informatics, and iot monitoring.
* integrate ai systems with digital thread/twin environments, plm/cad, mes/scada, and enterprise data platforms.
* develop apis and microservices for model orchestration and data ingestion.
* implement ci/cd workflows for ai workloads.
* build end\-to\-end pipelines for sensor, iot, and streaming data, including anomaly detection and predictive maintenance.
* collaborate with engineering and operations teams to shape deployable ai solutions.
* produce documentation, model explainability summaries, and technical reports.
* mentor junior engineers on ai/ml development.

**required qualifications**  

* b.s. or m.s. in computer science, engineering, data science, or related field.
* 5\+ years developing ai/ml pipelines with open\-source tools.
* experience operating ai stacks in production environments with git, docker, kubernetes, ci/cd.
* background in manufacturing, engineering, business informatics, or iot analytics.
* experience building api/microservice\-based ml applications.
* strong ability to structure ai solutions around complex operational challenges.
* excellent cross\-team communication and documentation skills.
* must be a u.s. citizen with ability to obtain and maintain doe clearance.

**preferred qualifications**  

* experience with digital thread/twin, plm/cad, mes/scada, or industrial iot.
* familiarity with mlops tools such as mlflow, kubeflow, prefect, dagster, or argo.
* knowledge of kafka, spark, airflow, or delta lake.
* experience with advanced ml methods (cv, nlp, rl, anomaly detection).
* experience deploying ai in regulated or high\-security environments.
* contributions to open\-source projects.

**what we offer**  

* competitive salary and benefits.
* flexible work schedules and paid time off (as applicable).
* professional development and mentorship.
* inclusive culture that values diverse perspectives.
* work that directly supports national security missions.
* continuous learning and career\-growth opportunities.

title: Sr. AI DevOps Developer- Bilingual (Korean/ English)
description:
**company description**  

for more open positions visit us at:  

***http://recruiting.woongjininc.com/***

**our mission**


woongjin inc. is a rapidly growing team who provides a range of unique, exceptional, and enhanced services to our clients. we have a strong moral code that includes the service of goodness without expectations of reward. we are motivated by the sense of responsibility and servant leadership.


benefits

* medical insurance
* vision insurance
* dental insurance
* 401(k)
* paid sick hours

  

**job description**  

we are seeking an ai devops engineer to design, develop, deploy, and support enterprise ai agents and generative ai solutions for clients, primarily in the consumer electronics and retail industries. this role combines hands\-on ai application development with devops and production support for ai solutions already deployed.

**key responsibilities**

* design and develop custom ai agents, genai applications, and ai\-powered automation based on client business requirements.
* develop, test, deploy, monitor, and continuously enhance ai solutions across development and production environments.
* work with client stakeholders to translate business requirements into practical ai solutions.
* implement and maintain rag pipelines, prompt engineering, agentic workflows, tool/function calling, and llm integrations.
* provide ongoing devops and production support, including monitoring, troubleshooting, performance optimization, upgrades, and incident resolution.
* build and maintain ci/cd pipelines and automated deployment processes.
* evaluate emerging ai models, frameworks, and technologies and recommend appropriate solutions for client projects.

**core skillsets**

* strong hands\-on experience developing applications using generative ai and llms
* experience with ai agents / agentic ai, including multi\-step workflows, tool/function calling, orchestration, and autonomous task execution.
* strong knowledge of rag architecture, including document processing, chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval strategies, and context management.
* strong prompt engineering skills, including prompt optimization, structured outputs, few\-shot prompting, and hallucination mitigation.
* experience with llm platforms such as openai / azure openai, anthropic, google gemini, aws bedrock, or equivalent.
* understanding of llm evaluation, ai application testing, model selection, token/cost optimization, latency, and scalability.
* experience integrating llms with enterprise applications, apis, databases, and business processes.
* knowledge of ai security considerations including prompt injection, data privacy, pii protection, access control, and responsible ai.
* strong programming experience in python; java, javascript/typescript, or c\# is a plus.
* experience developing rest apis, backend services, microservices, and enterprise integrations.
* experience with git, ci/cd, docker, and cloud environments such as azure, aws, or gcp.
* experience troubleshooting and supporting applications in production.

 **qualifications**  

* bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or related field
* 9\+ years of software development, ai, cloud, or devops experience, with hands\-on genai/llm development experience strongly preferred.
* experience working in an it consulting or client\-facing environment is highly desirable.
* strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, documentation, and problem\-solving skills.
* ability to manage multiple client projects and explain complex ai concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* bilingual preferred

 **additional information**  

all your information will be kept confidential according to eeo guidelines.


\*\*\*\*\*no c2c\*\*\*\*\*\*

title: Mid-Level Data Engineer
description:
we’re looking for a data engineer to build, improve, and support the data pipelines and infrastructure that power our products and organization. you’ll work with sql, python, spark/pyspark, databricks, aws, and infrastructure as code to develop reliable, scalable data solutions and help ensure the performance and quality of our production data environment.


you’ll collaborate with engineers, data scientists, and teams across crisis text line to translate data needs into thoughtful, maintainable solutions. we’re looking for someone with strong data engineering fundamentals and hands\-on experience building and supporting production data pipelines. you don’t need experience with every technology in our environment—we value transferable experience, curiosity, and the ability to learn and solve problems collaboratively.  

  

**our stack**


you’ll work across a modern, cloud\-based environment, including:

* **languages \& processing:** sql, python, spark/pyspark
* **data platform:** databricks
* **cloud:** aws
* **infrastructure as code:** terraform
* **observability:** datadog
* **data stores:** mysql, postgresql, and redis
* **delivery \& reliability:** automated ci/cd, monitoring, and shared ownership of production data pipelines

**responsibilities:**

* design, build, maintain, and improve reliable production data pipelines as part of our broader data and engineering environment.
* develop and optimize data processing workflows using sql, python, spark/pyspark, and databricks.
* partner with engineers, data scientists, and business teams to understand data needs and translate them into practical, maintainable solutions.
* build and maintain integrations between data sources and our data infrastructure.
* use infrastructure as code practices to support and improve our aws data environment.
* monitor pipeline health, data quality, and performance; troubleshoot issues and contribute to solutions when something isn’t working as expected.
* automate repeatable processes that improve the reliability, efficiency, and maintainability of our data pipelines.
* participate in shared production support and develop confidence diagnosing and resolving pipeline issues independently.
* contribute to code reviews, technical documentation, and engineering standards that help the team build reliable and maintainable systems.
* bring ideas, ask questions, and identify opportunities to improve our data tools, processes, and engineering practices over time.

**required qualifications:**

* approximately three to five years of professional data engineering, software engineering, or related experience, including meaningful responsibility for production data pipelines.
* professional experience using sql and python to build, transform, and troubleshoot data.
* experience building, maintaining, and supporting production data pipelines or etl/elt workflows.
* experience with distributed data processing technologies such as spark or pyspark.
* familiarity with cloud\-based environments such as aws and modern data engineering practices.
* experience testing, debugging, monitoring, and improving the reliability and performance of production data systems.
* the ability to independently complete well\-defined engineering work, investigate problems, and clearly communicate technical decisions, risks, and tradeoffs.
* a collaborative approach to working with engineers, data scientists, and cross\-functional partners, with a commitment to building secure and reliable data systems.

 **preferred qualifications**


the following experience would be useful, but we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every item:

* databricks or a comparable cloud\-based data platform.
* aws services and cloud\-based data architecture.
* terraform or another infrastructure\-as\-code tool.

* datadog or comparable monitoring and observability tools.
* data quality, automated testing, ci/cd, or deployment automation.
* designing data systems for reliability, performance, scalability, and security.
* supporting data used for analytics, reporting, or machine learning workloads.
* claude or other ai\-assistance code tools.
* working in a mission\-driven, regulated, safety\-sensitive, or high\-trust environment.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
**who we are**



samsara (nyse: iot) is the pioneer of the connected operations™ cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness internet of things (iot) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. at samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. representing more than 40% of global gdp, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.



working at samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including video\-based safety, vehicle telematics, apps and driver workflows, and equipment monitoring. as part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

**about the role:**



safety ai builds the ml and computer vision systems behind samsara's ai dash cameras which enable real\-time driver alerts, risk signals, and coaching insights running on millions of edge devices and the cloud.



this role owns what happens after training: building the resilient, low\-latency ml backend systems that turn static model artifacts into high\-throughput, cloud\-scale safety features.



you will partner closely with applied scientists, firmware and full\-stack engineers, and product managers and you will build the ml apis, data pipelines, and evaluation infrastructure that let safety ai models run efficiently at fleet scale, closing the loop from initial integration through rollout monitoring and iteration to a trustworthy, customer\-facing signal.



this is ml engineering where the stakes are real: rare, high\-consequence events, millions of vehicles, and a product where "it works" means someone got home safely. kindly refer to this video.



this is a remote role open to candidates residing in the us or canada.


**technical charter and impact:**


* own the cloud\-side path from model artifact to production system for safety ai's ml applications.
* establish practical standards for productionizing models — how they're served, evaluated, versioned, and monitored once they leave applied science.
* set a high bar for reliability: rigorous evaluation, measurable rollout health, and systems that degrade predictably rather than silently.
* act as a technical partner to applied scientists, helping translate research outputs into systems that are debuggable, scalable, and cost\-efficient in production.

#### **in this role, you will:**


* **design production ml apis:** architect and maintain reliable, low\-latency apis to integrate safety ai model outputs directly into cloud applications.
* **build data flywheels:** construct scalable pipelines to power continuous model iteration, backtesting, shadow and online evaluation, enabling fast and safe deployments.
* **optimize \& serve artifacts:** productionize model artifacts handed off by applied scientists, optimizing serving logic and fine\-tuning models for platform\-specific workloads.
* **petabyte\-scale operations:** process high\-volume camera and sensor telematics data to support model execution, backtesting, and automated dataset curation.
* **monitor \& maintain rollout health:** build systems to track model drift, precision/recall, and latency regressions in production, ensuring predictable failure modes and closed\-loop data feedback.
* **cross\-functional system integration:** partner with firmware and platform teams to optimize edge\-to\-cloud model execution, balancing latency, throughput, and infrastructure cost.
* **product collaboration:** work with product managers to translate safety requirements into scalable technical architectures.
* champion, role model, and embed samsara's cultural principles (focus on customer success, build for the long term, adopt a growth mindset, be inclusive, win as a team) as we scale globally and across new offices.


**minimum requirements for the role:**


* 6\+ years of experience as a machine learning engineer or similar role, with a track record of shipping models in production.
* strong proficiency in one or more common languages (e.g., c\+\+, golang, java, python, scala).
* proficiency with common ml tools (e.g. ray/ray serve, mlflow, grafana, pytorch, spark, etc).
* experience deploying and iteratively refining models using real customer feedback loops.
* comfort with full\-stack/backend development — you understand the data structures and dependencies underneath your models.
* bs or ms in computer science or a related quantitative field.


**an ideal candidate also has:**


* ph.d. in computer science or a quantitative discipline (e.g., applied math, physics, statistics).
* experience with containerization (docker, kubernetes), ci/cd pipelines, and infrastructure\-as\-code frameworks.
* experience deploying and managing ml applications in cloud environments (aws/gcp/azure), including cloud\-based storage, processing, and inference.
* experience shipping end\-to\-end ml applications from artifact to production, ideally in safety\-critical or high\-scale domains.
* expertise optimizing distributed model training with gpus.

**total rewards**



at samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. we want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high\-impact builders. our compensation program delivers above\-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance\-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high\-growth public company. we meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above\-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.



beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long\-term success: a flexible, employee\-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. if you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.


**flexible working**

drive development of existing software and contribute to development of new software by analyzing and identifying areas for modification and improvement. develop software that is fast, secure and reliable to meet defined requirements.

monitor, identify, and correct more complex software defects to maintain fully functioning software, leveraging the support and skill of more junior teammates.

produce multiple concepts and prototypes to design digital products/services.

research and suggest ways to optimize solutions to better meet user and/or business, performance, quality needs.

contribute to work within an established program management plan to achieve specific goals.

guide and deliver the design distribution of basic database resources and provide physical modeling and design services to tune database solutions for optimum performance.

support the collection functional requirements using document analysis and workflow analysis to express the requirements in terms of target user roles and goals.

anticipates and adopts innovations in business\-building digital and technology applications. for example, investigates technologies to learn some cutting\-edge best practices. uses digital/social media to benefit the team and add value to the work being done; understands how to avoid misuse of these tools.

* deliver high\-quality work and mentor junior engineers in technical skills
* conduct root cause analysis to address systemic issues and lead action plans
* design integrated systems that enable cross\-functional teams to deliver value at scale, speed, and reliability

* assess technical risks and implement prevention strategies

title: DevOps Engineer
description:

we are seeking a hands\-on **devops engineer** to help scale, secure, automate, and stabilize huloop’s cloud, hybrid, and customer\-hosted environments.

this role is critical to the reliability of our platform. the ideal candidate understands the importance of protecting production systems, managing change carefully, preventing repeat incidents, and ensuring that infrastructure, deployment, and configuration changes are thoroughly reviewed before release.

you will work closely with engineering, qa, cloud operations, production support, and product management to improve deployment reliability, system uptime, observability, security, scalability, vulnerability prevention, and release quality.

this role is well suited for someone who can use ai tools to improve speed and productivity, while applying the experience and judgment required to validate outputs before they are used in production.

**responsibilities**

* build, maintain, and improve ci/cd pipelines across development, qa, staging, and production environments.

**desired qualifications:**

* 3 to 7\+ years of experience in devops, cloud engineering, infrastructure engineering, site reliability engineering, or platform engineering.
* strong experience with microsoft azure environments.
* experience building and managing ci/cd pipelines using github, github actions, or similar tools.
* hands\-on experience with docker and containerized deployments.
* familiarity with container orchestration concepts.
* experience with infrastructure automation and infrastructure\-as\-code tools.
* strong working knowledge of linux server operations, including ubuntu and red hat enterprise linux.
* working knowledge of windows server, windows services, powershell, and enterprise windows environments.
* experience supporting mixed operating system environments across cloud, hybrid, and customer\-hosted deployments.
* experience with nginx, tls certificates, reverse proxy configuration, and web application routing.
* experience supporting production saas applications.
* strong understanding of cloud networking, monitoring, logging, operational security, and incident response.
* scripting or automation experience using powershell, python, bash, javascript, or similar languages.
* strong troubleshooting, documentation, and problem\-solving skills.
* sound judgment around production risk, change management, release readiness, and rollback planning.
* ability to work cross\-functionally in a fast\-paced startup environment.

**preferred experience:**

* experience supporting ai, automation, workflow orchestration, rpa, or agent\-based platforms.
* experience with java, maven, tomcat, spring boot, python, fastapi, .net, angular, and typescript environments.
* experience with sql server, mongodb, backup and restore processes, database connectivity, and performance monitoring.
* experience with azure key vault, managed identity, centralized secrets management, and least\-privilege access.
* experience with observability tools such as opentelemetry, prometheus, grafana, application insights, datadog, new relic, or similar platforms.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**our purpose**

*mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. we support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**title and summary**


senior data engineer
overview:
  

  

marketing services technology (mst) delivers the platforms, data products, and technology capabilities that power marketing measurement, customer insights, campaign optimization, and data\-driven decision making across mastercard.
  

  

we are seeking a senior data engineer to design, build, and operate scalable data platforms, pipelines, and services supporting marketing services products and analytics. this role partners closely with product, engineering, data science, analytics, and business stakeholders to deliver secure, reliable, high\-quality data solutions that enable campaign measurement, reporting, customer insights, ai/ml, and marketing optimization.
  

  

the ideal candidate brings strong ownership, accountability, and a proactive problem\-solving mindset; someone who takes initiative and drives issues to resolution independently rather than waiting for direction.
  

  

role:  

  

* design, build, deploy, and maintain scalable batch, streaming, and real\-time data pipelines supporting business\-critical products and analytics workloads.
* develop reusable frameworks and services for data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and delivery across multiple platforms and environments.
* build and support enterprise data warehouse, data lake, and lakehouse solutions for large\-scale processing and analytics.
* lead initiatives focused on platform scalability, performance, reliability, resiliency, and operational efficiency.
* implement and enhance data quality, observability, governance, security, lineage, and monitoring across data ecosystems.
* partner with product, engineering, analytics, and business teams to translate requirements into measurable business outcomes.
* support modernization and cloud migration initiatives, evolving legacy platforms to modern cloud\-native architectures.
* enable advanced analytics, reporting, ai/ml, experimentation, and customer insights through trusted data foundations.
* adhere to engineering best practices, ci/cd automation, infrastructure\-as\-code, and operational excellence.
* troubleshoot complex production issues and independently lead root\-cause analysis to improve platform stability and reliability.
* mentor engineers and provide technical leadership, promoting innovation and knowledge sharing.
* contribute to architectural decisions and technology roadmaps shaping the future of mst's data platforms.

  

all about you:  

  

* strong hands\-on experience with hive, spark/pyspark, apache kafka.
* proficiency in one or more programming languages such as python, java, scala, or sql.
* experience building scalable data platforms and distributed data processing solutions.
* experience developing data pipelines supporting analytics, reporting, machine learning, and operational data products.
* deep understanding of data modeling, etl/elt design patterns, data architecture, and data lifecycle management.
* knowledge of data governance, security, privacy, lineage, metadata management, and regulatory compliance.
* experience implementing ci/cd, devops automation, infrastructure\-as\-code, and observability frameworks.
* strong problem\-solving skills for diagnosing and resolving complex challenges in distributed environments.
* demonstrated ownership, accountability, initiative, and independent execution \- a builder who drives problems to resolution.
* strong communication and stakeholder management skills across engineering, product, analytics, and business.

  

preferred:  

  

* bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related technical discipline; advanced degree a plus.
* aws data engineering experience.
* azure data engineering / dataops exposure.
* marketing analytics or marketing technology domain knowledge.
* experience supporting large\-scale modernization or cloud migration initiatives.
* experience with data warehousing and cloud data engineering concepts and solutions.

description:
**a** re you an experienced, passionate pioneer in technology who wants to work in a collaborative environment? as an experienced senior data engineer\-senior consultant you will have the ability to share new ideas and collaborate on projects as a consultant without the extensive demands of travel. if so, consider an opportunity with deloitte under our project delivery talent model. project delivery model (pdm) is a talent model that is tailored specifically for long\-term, onsite client service delivery **.**  

  

work you'll do/responsibilities
  

* provide senior level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases. integrates third party products and has strong troubleshooting skills.
* translate technical specifications into code for moderately complex new or enhancement projects for internal clients. writes programs, develops code, tests artifacts, and produces reports. employs software development techniques to ensure tests are implemented in a way that support automation.
* elevate code into the development, test, and production environments on schedule. provides follow up production support. submits change control requests and documents.
* follow software development methodology. follows development architecture standards.
* participate in design, code, and test inspections throughout the life cycle to identify issues. participates in systems analysis activities.
* understand client business functions and technology needs. understands vanguard's tools, technologies, and applications/databases, including those that interface with business area and systems.
* learn and complies with information technology and information security policies and procedures.
* participate in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.

  

**the team**  

  

ai \& engineering leverages cutting\-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, ai, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. these solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission\-critical operations. we enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology \& data platforms. our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.  

  

**required qualifications**  

* 7\+ years of hands\-on experience in data engineering
* python aws development strong technical acumen in aws including expert working knowledge of aws services such as glue, ec2, ecs, lambda, step functions, iam, athena , hue, presto, s3, aws redshift etc.
* strong technical acumen in data engineering enablement, and working knowledge of frameworks/languages such as python, spark etc. dremio knowledge a plus
* python, pyspark, spark sql, sql server
* bachelor's degree, preferably in computer science, information technology, computer engineering, or related it discipline; or equivalent experience
* limited immigration sponsorship may be available
* ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

  

you may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.  

  

this position is aligned with the project talent model. to view the associated benefit package, please reference this document https://resources.deloitte.com/:b:/r/sites/dnet\-tod\-us/shared documents/benefits/benefitsjourney\_combined.pdf?csf\=1\&web\=1\&e\=zo0pt5 .  

  

deloitte is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for people with disabilities. if you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the recruiting process, please direct your inquiries to the global call center (gcc) at ustalentcicinbox@deloitte.com .

title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
we’re looking for hands\-on engineers with expertise and passion in solving difficult problems in distributed systems, operating systems, virtualized infrastructure, and highly available services. if this is you, at oracle you can design and build innovative new systems from the ground up. as our business grows, uptime for our cloud ecosystem is paramount. we engineer the real\-time detection and repair of our distributed cloud infrastructure. you will work with engineers from all product areas within oracle as we look to deliver next\-generation cloud services.


are you passionate about harnessing the power of artificial intelligence (ai) and machine learning (ml) to revolutionize cloud infrastructure and automation? do you thrive in environments where no two days are ever the same, and creativity meets cutting\-edge technology?


we're excited to meet a talented senior software engineer like you, who shares our enthusiasm for innovation and excellence. as a valued member of our software engineering division in seattle, you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of our technology stack and drive meaningful change in the world of cloud infrastructure and automation.


in this role, you'll design, develop, troubleshoot, and debug software programs for databases, applications, tools, networks, and other cloud infrastructure components. your expertise in ai and ml will help us stay ahead of the curve, and your passion for collaboration will inspire our team to achieve greatness together.


if you're ready to unleash your full potential and make a lasting impact, we'd love to hear from you!


location: seattle, wa (there is no remote option for this role)


  
**key responsibilities:**

* work independently in ambiguous situations to ensure adherence to published standards and practices.
* design, develop, troubleshoot, and debug software programs for various cloud infrastructure components, including databases, applications, tools, and networks.
* take an active role in defining and evolving standard practices and procedures for software engineering, with a focus on ai\-driven development.
* define and develop software for tasks associated with developing, designing, and debugging software applications or operating systems, leveraging ai and ml techniques.
* lead the development of critical initiatives, including:
	+ design and implement spike detection mechanisms for provisioning failures to minimize operational disruptions using ml algorithms.
	+ expand integrations with kafka to enable near real\-time actions supporting 1\-day slo objectives for hardware repairs, utilizing event\-driven architecture and stream processing.
	+ developing an automated ticket routing framework to streamline workflows, enhance efficiency, and reduce operational overhead, powered by nlp and ml.
	+ accelerate dedicated initiatives through collaborative efforts with cross\-functional teams and customers, applying ai\-driven insights and recommendations.
	+ harness the power of ai and ml to create innovative tools and frameworks that automate testing, simulate complex environments, and reproduce incidents, freeing up human ingenuity to focus on higher\-value tasks and amplifying our ability to deliver exceptional customer experiences.
* collaborate and lead technical discussions across multiple teams to ensure seamless integrations and effective problem\-solving.
provide direction and mentoring to junior engineers, sharing knowledge and expertise to promote growth and development.  
* 

**technical skills:**

* programming languages: python, java, typescript
* messaging platforms: kafka
* development methodologies: agile principles
* user experience (ux) design principles
* data management: data modeling, data warehousing, data governance
* cloud infrastructure: oci, aws, azure, google cloud platform (gcp)
* operating systems: linux, macos
* scripting languages: bash, perl, ruby
* familiarity with containerization technologies such as docker
* api design and development: restful apis, api gateways, api security
* familiarity with api documentation tools such as swagger/openapi
* ai and ml frameworks: tensorflow, pytorch, keras, scikit\-learn
* nlp libraries: nltk, spacy
* experience with ai\-powered tools and platforms: chatbots, virtual assistants, predictive analytics

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
**enterprise knowledge** (ek) is hiring a full\-time **full stack developer** to join our growing enterprise delivery team. in this role, you will bridge the gap between robust software engineering and cutting\-edge generative ai, designing, leading implementation, and deploying end\-to\-end solutions that transform how global organizations interact with their data.


as a **full stack developer**, you will be part of a team working on innovative projects, ranging from intelligent search interfaces to complex agentic ai systems that automate intricate business workflows. we are seeking a proactive, independent thinker with a passion for building functional, user\-centric ai applications that can lead system design. our forward\-deployed developers work alongside business stakeholders and customer development teams to design, build, and implement solutions that meet critical business needs


as an eker, you will join a fast\-growing company that is committed to equity and inclusion, have the opportunity to work in a collaborative workplace, take advantage of our unique **benefits**, and help build our innovative culture. to read more about the impactful work we are doing and to see the latest thought leadership from ek, follow us on **linkedin**.


responsibilities* full stack development: design, implement, and maintain scalable backend microservices (python) and intuitive frontend interfaces (react/vue) for ai\-driven applications
* system design: lead the design of system components and communicate said system design to both technical and non\-technical clients alike
* production readiness: design, maintain, and implement solutions that adhere to security, access controls, scalability, and other constraints informed by client requirements
* ai orchestration: implementation of agentic ai solutions, including orchestration patterns, tool use, and memory/retrieval integration
* rag \& nlp: design and operate end\-to\-end retrieval augmented generation (rag) workflows, including retrieval pipeline architecture, embedding strategies, and response evaluation
* data integration: lead development of and optimize data pipelines for ingesting and enriching structured and unstructured content using sql, python, and other scripting or querying strategies
* semantic integration: work with internal teams to integrate ai components with semantic layers and knowledge graph implementations
* security and access control: design, configure, and advise clientele on production\-grade system security, access control (rbac/abac), and network architecture (ingress/egress)
* api \& middleware: design and develop middleware integration layers for decoupled systems, including content auto\-tagging and seamless search experiences
* client collaboration: work with data subject matter experts and business users to understand their domain and communicate technical insights to non\-technical stakeholders

  

**requirements**  

as a federal contractor, enterprise knowledge will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization or offer any immigration related support for this position (i.e., h1b, f\-1 opt, f\-1 stem opt, f\-1 cpt, j\-1, tn, e\-2, e\-3, l\-1, and o\-1, or any eads or other forms of work authorization that require immigration support from an employer.


this hybrid role requires that you live within a comfortable, commutable distance of our arlington, va office and that you are willing to be on\-site 2 days a week.

**required skills and experience:*** education: bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, math, or a related technical field
* experience: 2\-5 years of professional software development experience, with a focus on both backend and frontend technologies
* programming: proficiency in python (preferred) or java for backend development, and experience with modern javascript frameworks (e.g., react, typescript)
* data \& databases: familiarity with data modeling, database architecture, and sql
* tooling: experience with code versioning tools (git), ci/cd (github actions), and delivering solutions using agile delivery practices
* ai\-augmented development: proficiency in using generative ai tools to accelerate the full software development life cycle (sdlc). this includes leveraging ai for generating architecture decision records (adrs), drafting code, creating comprehensive test cases, and producing product documentation
* communication: strong ability to facilitate meetings, provide briefings, and present work products and solution design directly to clients

**preferred skills and experience:*** graph technologies: experience with rdf graph databases, sparql, or linked data technologies
* devops \& cloud: comfort working with containerized environments (docker) and cloud platforms (aws, azure, or gcp) for deploying ai solutions
* ai observability: experience implementing monitoring for ai components, including latency, success rate, and retrieval quality
* semantic web: exposure to ontology/taxonomy design or management tools (e.g., progress semaphore, poolparty)
* ai: proven experience designing, building, and optimizing rag pipelines (embeddings, reranking, and evaluation) and applying natural language processing (nlp) techniques to unstructured data

**salary information:**
ek considers a broad range of factors in considering employee salary, including a candidate’s skills, experience, education, certifications, past successes, and qualifications. the salary range for this role is $95,000 to $115,000, with most candidates likely to fall in the lower half. this range does not guarantee a specific salary and may be adjusted based on the needs of the company and the candidate’s qualifications.

**data privacy notice:**
enterprise knowledge (ek) is committed to protecting your personal information. when you submit your application, we collect and process your personal data solely for recruitment and hiring purposes. we will not use your information for any other purpose without your explicit consent.


we may share your information with third parties only as necessary to evaluate your application or comply with legal requirements. if we need to use your data for a purpose beyond the original intent or disclose it to additional third parties, we will provide you with prior notice.


you have the right to access the personal information we hold about you and to request corrections, amendments, or deletion of any inaccurate data or data processed in violation of applicable privacy principles. requests for such changes will be reviewed and accommodated unless the burden or expense of providing access would be disproportionate to the risks to your privacy, or where the rights of other individuals may be affected.


by submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this notice. if you have any questions about how we handle your personal data or need to update your information, please contact us at careers@enterprise\-knowledge.com.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**company description**  

domino’s is a purpose\-inspired, performance\-driven company powered by exceptional people who are committed to feeding the power of possible—one pizza at a time. founded in 1960 as a single store in ypsilanti, michigan, domino’s has grown into the largest pizza company in the world, with more than 22,300 stores across 90\+ markets. our success is built on the strength of our people, technology, and franchise system. as a leader in innovation, we continue to transform the pizza and qsr industry while creating opportunities for team members to learn, grow and thrive. if you're ready to make an impact, build a meaningful career and help shape what's next, there's a place for you at domino's.

 **job description**  

as a senior data engineer, you will operate as a technical expert responsible for designing, building, and scaling enterprise\-grade data engineering solutions across our cloud\-native data platform on azure and databricks. this role requires deep technical knowledge, strong engineering judgment, and the ability to deliver high\-impact solutions that support analytics, ai/ml, operational reporting, and streaming data solutions.


you will partner closely with data architects, platform admins, cloud engineers, product owners, and cross\-functional stakeholders to translate strategy and architecture into production\-grade high\-quality solutions. you will lead complex technical work within your domain, mentor engineers, raise engineering standards, and influence delivery across multiple products, platforms, and business capabilities.

**general responsibilities**

* apply advanced technical knowledge to design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines, reusable engineering frameworks, and platform capabilities using azure data factory, databricks, spark, streaming and related cloud\-native technologies.
* lead engineering design and implementation for ingestion, transformation, and data product frameworks that support structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured data at enterprise scale.
* implement automation for data ingestion, processing, validation, and monitoring to ensure reliability and observability.
* drive implementation of future\-state data architecture and cloud migration patterns, ensuring solutions are reliable, secure, maintainable, and aligned to enterprise modernization goals.
* optimize data workflows for performance and cost, leveraging delta lake, partitioning, caching, and compute scaling strategies.
* define data access controls and rbac policies in collaboration with security and governance teams.
* provide technical leadership within the team by mentoring engineers, reviewing solution designs, setting engineering standards, and promoting best practices for ci/cd, testing, automation, observability, and cloud\-native delivery.
* partner with ai/ml, analytics, and business teams to enable high\-value real\-time and batch data activation use cases that improve decision\-making and business outcomes.
* ensure compliance with data governance, privacy, and security standards.

  

**qualifications**  

* 8\+ years of experience in data engineering, including experience delivering complex, enterprise\-scale data solutions; azure experience preferred.
* advanced technical expertise in cloud based data warehouses (databricks preferred), spark, delta lake, azure services, data integration, data modeling, and performance optimization.
* proven experience in building and optimizing large\-scale etl/elt pipelines and data lakehouse architectures.
* solid understanding of data lakehouse modeling, data warehousing, and performance tuning.
* experience with customer 360 data products, identity resolution, customer profile enrichment, and activation use cases is highly desired.
* experience designing and supporting streaming data solutions is highly desired, including kafka or similar event streaming platforms.
* martech exposure is preferred, including experience supporting marketing, personalization, campaign, loyalty, or customer engagement data use cases.
* experience with infrastructure as code (terraform, arm templates) and devops tools (git, azure devops, jenkins).
* familiarity with rbac, data security, and compliance frameworks.
* strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical direction, clarify tradeoffs, and align engineering decisions across teams and stakeholders.
* experience with agile methodologies and working in cross\-functional product teams.
* demonstrated ability to lead through influence, mentor engineers, manage technical ambiguity, and drive outcomes across a broad scope of products, platforms, and stakeholders.

  

**additional information**  

benefits:  

* paid holidays and vacation
* medical, dental \& vision benefits that start on the first day of employment
* no\-cost mental health support for employee and dependents
* childcare tuition discounts
* no\-cost fitness, nutrition, and wellness programs
* fertility benefits
* adoption assistance
* 401k matching contributions
* 15% off the purchase price of stock
* company bonus
  

all your information will be kept confidential according to eeo guidelines.

-------------------

* understanding of application monitoring, logging, troubleshooting, and production support practices.
* strong collaboration, problem\-solving, and communication skills with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.

title: Data Scientist focus on Cybersecurity
description:
**job summary**

we are seeking a dynamic and innovative data scientist with a specialized focus on cybersecurity to join our forward\-thinking analytics team. in this role, you will leverage advanced machine learning techniques, statistical modeling, and big data systems to identify, analyze, and mitigate cybersecurity threats. your expertise will drive the development of ai\-powered security solutions, enhance threat detection capabilities, and contribute to safeguarding our digital infrastructure. this position offers an exciting opportunity to work at the forefront of cybersecurity analytics, utilizing cutting\-edge tools and cloud services to create scalable and impactful security models.

**duties**

* develop and implement machine learning models for real\-time threat detection and anomaly identification in large\-scale cybersecurity datasets.
* utilize unsupervised learning techniques to uncover hidden patterns and emerging threats within complex data environments.
* design and optimize etl (extract, transform, load) processes to prepare data from diverse sources such as sql databases, hadoop, spark, and cloud platforms like aws for analysis.
* collaborate with cross\-functional teams to integrate ai models into existing security infrastructure and automate threat response workflows.
* conduct statistical analysis for research purposes, evaluating model performance through rigorous model training, evaluation, and deployment procedures.
* apply natural language processing (nlp) techniques to analyze unstructured data such as logs, alerts, or threat intelligence feeds.
* leverage machine learning frameworks like tensorflow and spark implementation for scalable model training and deployment across big data systems.

**skills**

* proficiency in programming languages including python, r, java, c, bash (unix shell), and vba for data analysis and model development.
* extensive experience with machine learning/ai frameworks such as tensorflow, spark mllib, and generative ai tools for predictive modeling analysis.
* strong knowledge of big data systems including hadoop, spark, talend, and sql databases for managing large\-scale datasets.
* expertise in cloud\-based ai implementation using aws machine learning cloud services for scalable analytics solutions.
* skilled in statistical modeling techniques and statistical analysis tools for research and threat assessment purposes.
* familiarity with database design principles and data mining methodologies to optimize data storage and retrieval processes.
* experience with natural language processing (nlp), data analytics platforms like looker, and data visualization tools to communicate insights effectively.
* understanding of quantum engineering concepts is a plus for advanced cybersecurity applications.

join us if you’re passionate about harnessing the power of ai and machine learning to revolutionize cybersecurity! bring your expertise in big data systems, statistical analysis, cloud services, and ai implementation to help protect digital assets worldwide while advancing your career in a fast\-paced environment dedicated to innovation.

pay: from $100,000\.00 per year

benefits:

* health insurance
* paid time off

title: Senior Azure DevOps & Cloud Platform Engineer
description:
built on meritocracy, our unique company culture rewards self\-starters and those who are committed to doing what is best for our customers.

**bridge specialty group** is seeking a **senior azure devops \&** **cloud** **platform engineer** to join our growing team in **plano, tx.**


we are seeking a talented and experienced senior azure devops \& cloud platform engineer to join the bridge specialty group it organization. reporting to the head of it architecture, this role will be responsible for working with the team and evolving the enterprise devops platform, cloud automation capabilities, ci/cd standards, and infrastructure as code practices across the organization.


this position will work closely with the architecture team, cloud engineering teams, application development teams, and enterprise technology partners to enable secure, scalable, and highly automated software delivery. the successful candidate will join the devops team, which owns and operates the azure devops platform and related cloud engineering functions.

 **how you will contribute:**

**cloud platform engineering \& infrastructure automation**

* design, implement, and support infrastructure as code solutions using terraform, bicep, arm templates, and aws cloudformation.
* automate provisioning and lifecycle management of cloud infrastructure across azure and aws environments.
* develop cloud deployment standards and operational runbooks.
* collaborate with cloud engineering teams to improve platform reliability, scalability, and operational effectiveness.
 **continuous integration \& continuous delivery**

* design, build, and maintain enterprise ci/cd pipelines supporting application, infrastructure, and integration deployments.
* automate build, testing, deployment, and release processes.
* implement deployment quality gates, automated validations, and compliance controls.
* reduce manual deployment activities through automation and self\-service capabilities.
 **azure cloud engineering**

* support and optimize enterprise azure services, including azure kubernetes service, azure api management, azure service bus, azure functions, azure app services, azure sql database, azure storage, azure key vault, azure monitor, and application insights.
* partner with application teams to implement cloud\-native deployment patterns.
 **aws platform support**

* support and maintain workloads deployed within aws environments.
* work with aws services, including lambda, api gateway, ecs/eks, s3, rds, cloudwatch, iam, sns, and sqs.
* assist with hybrid\-cloud and multi\-cloud integration patterns where azure and aws services interact.
* support cloud cost optimization and operational governance initiatives.
 **devsecops** **\& compliance**

* implement and maintain devsecops controls within ci/cd pipelines.
* integrate security scanning, vulnerability assessments, and policy validation into deployment processes.
* partner with security teams to implement secure development lifecycle practices.
* support audit, compliance, and regulatory requirements applicable to insurance and financial services environments.
 **platform reliability \& operational excellence**

* implement monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability capabilities across cloud platforms.
* improve system reliability through automation, monitoring, and proactive operational practices.
* participate in troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and production support activities.
* develop and maintain operational documentation and platform standards.
 **continuous learning \& innovation**

* stay current on emerging cloud technologies, devops methodologies, platform engineering practices, and automation tools.
* champion continuous improvement and modernization initiatives.
* contribute to technology communities of practice and knowledge\-sharing efforts.
* additional responsibilities consistent with the role objectives may be added as needed to support the profit center.
 **skills \& experience to be successful:**

**required**

* bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.
* 7\+ years of experience in devops, cloud engineering, platform engineering, site reliability engineering, or related disciplines.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on azure devops administration and implementation experience.
* strong experience designing and supporting enterprise ci/cd pipelines.
* strong expertise with azure devops, git, terraform, bicep, powershell, azure cli, docker, and kubernetes.
* experience supporting azure cloud services and cloud\-native applications.
* experience implementing infrastructure as code and automation frameworks.
* strong troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills.
* experience working across multiple technical teams and stakeholders.
* ability to independently own the devops function, manage transitions, and support multiple delivery teams.
 **preferred**

* aws experience supporting production cloud environments.
* experience with aws lambda, api gateway, ecs/eks, cloudformation, and cloudwatch.
* experience implementing devsecops programs and security automation.
* experience supporting enterprise application modernization initiatives.
* experience in the insurance or financial services industry.
* azure and/or aws certifications.
* experience supporting platform engineering, internal developer platforms, or self\-service cloud capabilities.

description:

**position summary**


as a member of the eva data engineering team at optum technology, you will transform eva usage data into meaningful analyses and actionable insights. leveraging google cloud data fusion and modern data platform capabilities, you will contribute to building and maintaining reliable data pipelines that process usage metrics to support data\-driven decision\-making across the enterprise. in this remote role, you will collaborate with cross\-functional technical teams to design efficient data integration workflows, automate data processing, and leverage modern tools to continuously improve our data assets.


you'll enjoy the flexibility to telecommute\* from anywhere within the u.s. as you take on some tough challenges.

**primary responsibilities:**

* transform eva usage data into structured datasets and meaningful analytical outputs using google cloud data fusion
* assist in designing, building, and maintaining robust data integration workflows and etl/elt pipelines
* use enterprise\-approved ai tools to streamline workflows, automate data engineering tasks, and drive continuous process improvement
* assist in designing, developing, and deploying ai\-powered data solutions to address complex business challenges with an emphasis on responsible ai usage
* evaluate emerging technology trends to inform solution design, pipeline optimization, and strategic innovation
* write clean, efficient sql queries and data transformation scripts to support analytics and operational reporting
* monitor daily data processing workflows, troubleshoot pipeline failures, and perform data profiling to ensure data quality and accuracy
* document data pipeline workflows, data mapping specifications, and system architectures for team reference


you'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear directions on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

**required qualifications:**

* high school diploma/ged
* 1\+ years of experience in data engineering, data analysis, or software development
* 1\+ years of experience working with relational databases and writing sql queries
* 1\+ years of experience with programming or scripting languages (e.g., python, scala, or java) for data processing
* foundational knowledge of etl/elt pipeline concepts, data transformation techniques, and data warehousing principles
* willingness and ability to learn and build data pipelines using google cloud data fusion (prior experience with google cloud data fusion is not required)
* demonstrated ability to analyze, profile, and troubleshoot data quality or pipeline performance issues

**preferred qualifications:**

* bachelor's degree in computer science, data science, information technology, or a related field
* prior experience with or exposure to google cloud platform (gcp) services, including google cloud data fusion or bigquery
* experience or familiarity with utilizing ai\-assisted development tools to optimize daily workflows and data pipeline creation
* exposure to cloud data platform architectures and cloud\-native data integration tools
* knowledge of workflow orchestration tools (e.g., airflow) or big data processing frameworks
* familiarity with devops principles, ci/cd deployment pipelines, and version control tools (e.g., git)
* all telecommuters will be required to adhere to unitedhealth group's telecommuter policy.
