title: Senior DevSecOps & Network Infrastructure Engineer
description:
### **description**

  

**about kwi**  

kwi builds the unified commerce platform that powers some of the world's most recognized specialty and luxury retail brands. behind every transaction, every clienteling interaction, and every store opening is an infrastructure team that keeps the lights on and is continuously raising the bar on how modern, and how secure, that platform runs. this is a role on that team.  

**the opportunity**  

if innovation lives in your dna and ai is already part of how you think, build, and operate, you're going to love what we're doing at kwi. you'll join a small, senior team with a real mandate to design, build, secure, and run the systems that power retail at scale. this is hands\-on, on\-prem infrastructure work: our own hypervisors, our own network edge, our own containers, and our own pipelines. we move fast, we automate aggressively, and we expect security to be built into the platform rather than bolted onto it. your fingerprints will be on the platform every day.### **the impact you'll make**

  

* design, harden, and operate our on\-prem footprint: vmware vsphere clusters, linux virtual machines, and docker workloads running across multiple datacenters and serving retail clients 24x7\.
* own the network edge. fortigate policy design, nat and vips, ipsec site\-to\-site and remote\-access vpn, segmentation, ips and utm profiles, and disciplined change control on every rule you touch.
* build security into the delivery pipeline. container image and dependency scanning, sast, secrets detection, iac policy checks, signed artifacts, and vulnerability findings you drive to closure instead of to a spreadsheet.
* containerize and template services with docker and infrastructure\-as\-code so deployments are repeatable, declarative, and boring.
* run the secrets and pki plane: centralized secrets management, an internal certificate authority, automated certificate issuance and rotation, and a standing campaign to get hardcoded credentials out of the environment.
* own incidents end to end: triage alerts, drive root\-cause analysis across the application, network, database, and hypervisor layers, and write the post\-incident docs that stop recurrence.
* improve observability across the fleet. metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and firewall and flow telemetry, so problems are seen before customers feel them.
* support audit, compliance, and penetration\-test work: evidence collection, remediation slas, access reviews, and hardening baselines that hold up under scrutiny.
* use modern ai\-augmented engineering tools (claude code, mcp\-based workflows, agentic automation) as a daily multiplier, to operate faster and extend what one engineer can deliver.
* document and mentor. runbooks, network diagrams, and design docs aren't an afterthought here. they're how the team scales.

  

### **what you will bring**

 **required*** 5\+ years operating production linux/unix (rhel, centos/rocky, debian/ubuntu) in an on\-prem or hybrid environment at meaningful scale.
* hands\-on enterprise firewall experience, ideally fortigate/fortios: policy design, nat and vips, ipsec and ssl vpn, routing, ha pairs, and the judgment to change a live rule set safely. deep palo alto or cisco asa/firepower experience plus a genuine willingness to go deep on fortinet also works.
* strong networking fundamentals: tcp/ip, vlans and segmentation, routing, dns, tls, http/s, and load balancing. you can read a packet capture and a certificate chain and say what is actually happening.
* production vmware vsphere experience: clusters and hosts, datastores, resource contention, snapshots and templates, and patching without an outage.
* docker in production: image builds and hardening, registries, compose\-based or orchestrated deployment, container networking, and troubleshooting the container that will not stay up.
* practical devsecops: ci/cd pipelines with security gates, vulnerability management and cve remediation at fleet scale, secrets management, and image scanning.
* solid devops fundamentals: git, ci/cd pipelines, ansible (or similar configuration management), terraform/opentofu (or similar iac), and docker.
* comfortable scripting in bash. python is not required, but you should have a working understanding of programming fundamentals and be able to read, modify, and write straightforward code.
* strong troubleshooting instincts and the temperament to lead under pressure.

  

**key skills (we'll weigh heavily)*** real day\-to\-day experience using ai\-augmented engineering tools (claude, cursor, copilot, mcp servers, agentic workflows), not just demos.
* firewall and network security operations at the edge of a production e\-commerce platform: rule hygiene, attack\-surface reduction, and closing external pen\-test findings.
* experience with a centralized secrets manager (hashicorp vault, openbao, or comparable) and internal pki or certificate automation.
* experience with datadog, grafana, or comparable observability platforms.

  

**nice to have*** security certifications such as fortinet nse 4 or higher, security\+, cissp, or oscp, or equivalent demonstrated depth.
* exposure to compliance frameworks that touch retail (pci dss, soc 2\) and the evidence work that comes with them.
* mysql operational experience: replication, performance tuning, backups, and recovery.
* load balancer experience (kemp/loadmaster, f5, haproxy, nginx), including ssl offload and waf policy.
* multi\-datacenter, disaster\-recovery, or failover\-testing experience.
* retail, e\-commerce, or pos\-adjacent operational experience.

  

### **as a member of the kwi team you will receive**

  

* full medical, dental and vision
* annual bonus eligible
* free gym in the building
* generous pto policy
* summer fridays....all year round
* tuition reimbursement
* discount from building café
* 401(k) with a 50% company match (up to 6% of employee contribution)
* employee referral program
* (1\) volunteer day each year


  

**our work space**  


we understand that our teams need flexibility, which is why we follow a hybrid schedule. our in\-office days of monday, tuesday and thursday, and employees are allowed to work remotely on wednesdays and friday.  

we are also a collaborative group and believe that getting together in person allows our team to do their best work. together we enjoy monthly events, bagels every thursday, a state\-of\-the\-art coffee machine, a full snack pantry and many more surprise and delight moments throughout the year.
  

**our commitment to you**  


at kwi, we know that cultivating diversity and fostering an inclusive work environment is critical to our impact and success. we create an environment where no individual is advantaged or disadvantaged because of their background. we offer equal opportunity employment regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability status, age, marital status, or protected veteran status.  

with a commitment to maintaining a bias\-free environment in which harassment is prohibited, we respect cultural diversity and comply with the laws of the places in which we operate. we expect our business partners, suppliers, clients, and all our team members to uphold these commitments.### **about kwi**


kwi helps retailers maximize sales by uniting their online and in\-store capabilities to deliver delightful shopper experiences. with kwi **merchandising and mobile pos**, retailers can execute omnichannel flawlessly, and right at their fingertips — clienteling, endless aisle, mobile checkout with the latest payment options, **inventory management, and ecommerce**.

title: Test Engineer
description:
**position overview**
=====================


the test engineer is a member of the aamva quality assurance department within the it division, responsible for testing aamva applications and the rest services and microservices that compose them, and for supporting testing efforts with state and federal jurisdictions and commercial/third\-party data consumers on motor vehicle administration and driver licensing systems. this role executes and contributes to test plans, runs functional and automated tests, and participates in testing sessions with external customers, working with a degree of independence and seeking guidance from senior team members on complex initiatives. it is a strong foundation for building modern quality engineering skills and growing toward senior technical roles.

**about aamva**
===============


the it division develops and operates information systems for state and federal agencies conducting business related to motor vehicle and driver license administration. our systems support critical government functions across multiple jurisdictions. our systems run on a cloud\-native, microservices architecture on azure with rest interfaces across all internal and external integrations, and we invest in automation\-first, ai\-assisted test engineering. our in\-house test platform abstracts much of the underlying infrastructure, so we value strong test\-design judgment, data and integration testing depth, and learning agility over pre\-existing mastery of any single platform technology.

**key responsibilities**
========================

**testing \& quality assurance**
--------------------------------

* create, execute, and maintain test cases, and contribute to test plans for aamva applications and their underlying rest services and microservices.
* conduct functional, system, integration, and regression testing based on aamva's business and technical specifications.
* build and maintain automated test scripts across ui, api/rest, and service layers, and run them within ci/cd pipelines.
* perform api testing of restful services — request/response and schema validation, status codes, and authentication.
* use existing service\-virtualization and mocks to test components in isolation and manage test data (create/modify/reset) so tests are atomic and repeatable.
* validate data across relational and nosql data stores (azure sql, cosmos db).
* participate in testing for jurisdictions and partners making system or platform changes, ensuring quality standards are maintained.
* apply ai\-assisted testing tools to speed up test creation, debugging, and reporting.
**defect \& issue management**
------------------------------

* log, track, and manage defects through resolution using established tracking systems (e.g. jira, azure devops).
* communicate issues clearly to technical teams and stakeholders, with steps to reproduce and supporting detail.
* help determine whether a failure originates in the application, the test data, or a mocked dependency, escalating complex cases to senior team members.
**customer engagement \& support**
----------------------------------

* facilitate and conduct testing sessions with jurisdictions and commercial/third\-party consumers (e.g. dldv, consumer\-access, and cdlis third\-party customers) implementing new or enhanced applications.
* conduct customer outreach including surveys, scheduling, and consultations.
* build and maintain strong, positive relationships with internal and external customers.
**collaboration \& communication**
----------------------------------

* attend meetings on testing schedules, concerns, reviews, and documentation changes, and participate actively in work groups.
* collaborate with cross\-functional teams including developers, business analysts, and project managers.
* participate in the review of testing and procedural documentation.
**learning, knowledge \& continuous improvement**
-------------------------------------------------

* build and maintain proficiency in aamva applications and the team's testing tools through ongoing training and hands\-on experience.
* provide input and recommendations to improve testing processes, efficiency, and the customer experience.
**formal education**
====================


four\-year degree from an accredited college or university; equivalent work experience may be substituted for the degree.

**experience \& technical skills**
==================================

*the skills below are described by the depth we expect. “strong / hands\-on” indicates required, working depth. “familiarity / awareness” indicates that exposure is sufficient — our test tooling abstracts much of the underlying platform, and the ability to learn quickly matters more than deep prior expertise in those areas.*

* **3–5 years** of software quality assurance and testing experience with a solid understanding of the software development lifecycle.
* **solid test\-design ability** — creating and executing test cases and contributing to test plans, including basic edge and negative cases.
* **strong analytical skills and learning agility** — able to reason about system behavior and quickly become proficient in new tools and proprietary applications. \*(non\-negotiable.) \*
* **working knowledge** of functional, system, integration, regression, and **rest/api testing**.
* **working, hands\-on knowledge of databases and sql**, including validating data across relational and nosql stores (azure sql, cosmos db).
* **hands\-on experience** with test management and defect tracking tools (jira, azure devops/alm, or similar).
* **familiarity** with automated testing frameworks and tools (selenium, postman, playwright, or similar).
* **familiarity** with using service virtualization / mocks and managing test data for isolated, repeatable tests.
* **awareness** of the azure request\-path components (api management, application gateway, web application firewall) — enough to recognize when a failure may originate outside the application.
* **conceptual understanding** of cloud\-hosted, microservices environments; platform expertise is not required.
* **familiarity** with ci/cd pipelines, and exposure to ai\-assisted testing.
* ability to troubleshoot technical issues, escalating complex problems to senior team members.
**communication \& customer service**
=====================================

* excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* demonstrated ability to deliver high\-quality customer service to internal teams and external jurisdictions and partners.
* experience facilitating meetings and testing sessions with stakeholders.
* ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical audiences.
**professional attributes**
===========================

* self\-motivated, able to work with a degree of independence while seeking guidance on complex issues.
* exceptional attention to detail and analytical thinking.
* proactive problem\-solver with critical\-thinking ability.
* eager to learn and grow toward senior technical roles.
**preferred qualifications**
============================

* knowledge of aamva applications, systems, and standards.
* experience with government or public\-sector it systems in motor vehicle administration or driver licensing.
* exposure to data analytics and bi pipelines (e.g. synapse, power bi).
* understanding of or exposure to white box testing.
* familiarity with scripting languages (javascript, powershell, python, or similar).
* istqb foundation level or working toward relevant qa certifications.
  

salary range**:** $99,606 to $147,849 annually

*the expected hiring range for this position has been provided. actual pay will be determined based on the candidate's experience, qualifications, specific skill sets, and geographic work location.*

 **aamva is an equal opportunity employer/veterans/disabled**

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, AISWP (Hybrid)
description:
**the application window is expected to close on:** 10/29/2026this is a hybrid position based out of cisco's seattle or san jose office.
  
  

meet the team
  
  

the cisco ai research team brings together ai researchers, machine learning engineers, data engineers, and networking domain experts to build the next generation of ai\-powered networking.
  
  

we work at the intersection of generative ai, large\-scale data systems, and networking, developing large language models (llms), agents, and domain\-specific ai systems. our work spans research and engineering, with a strong focus on translating advances in ai into scalable systems and real\-world impact.
  
  

your impact
  
  

as a senior machine learning engineer, you will build and improve the data and ml systems that power our llms and ai models.
  
  

a major focus of this role is solving one of the most important challenges in modern ai: creating high\-quality training and evaluation data at scale. you will design and build scalable data pipelines, improve human data labeling workflows, create synthetic datasets, and develop automated approaches for continuously measuring and improving dataset quality.
  
  

this is a hands\-on technical role at the intersection of machine learning engineering and data engineering. you will work closely with researchers, engineers, and domain experts to determine what data our models need, how to create it efficiently, and how to measure its impact on model performance.
  
  

what you’ll do
  
  

* design, build, and own end\-to\-end data pipelines for ml and llm training, post\-training, evaluation, and continuous model improvement.
* build and improve human\-in\-the\-loop data labeling pipelines, including data collection, task generation, annotation workflows, quality control, and feedback integration.
* develop scalable approaches for synthetic data generation, augmentation, filtering, and validation to improve dataset quality, diversity, and coverage.
* apply llms and other ml techniques to automate data generation, labeling, filtering, scoring, and evaluation.
* develop systems and metrics to continuously measure dataset quality, including label quality, duplication, contamination, coverage, bias, and distribution shifts.
* build reliable and scalable infrastructure for processing large volumes of structured and unstructured data.
* design experiments to understand how dataset quality and composition affect downstream model performance, and use those insights to drive improvements.
* partner with researchers and ml engineers to develop datasets for model training, fine\-tuning, preference learning, evaluation, and agent development.
* translate research ideas and prototypes into robust, production\-ready data and ml systems.
* make architectural and technical decisions across data pipelines, ml infrastructure, storage, compute, and evaluation systems.
* provide technical leadership through design reviews, engineering best practices, mentoring, and cross\-functional collaboration.


minimum qualifications
  
  

* bachelor’s degree in a stem field with 7\+ years of relevant experience, or master’s degree in a stem field with 4\+ years of relevant experience, or phd in stem or a relevant technical field with 1\+ years of industry or academic research experience.
* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience building, curating, and scaling datasets for machine learning training and evaluation.
* 3\+ years of professional programming experience using python, c\+\+, or go within a production or research environment.
* 3\+ years of experience using machine learning frameworks such as pytorch, tensorflow, or equivalent technologies to develop, train, evaluate, and deploy machine learning models.


preferred qualifications
  
  

* expertise in curating, scaling, and managing datasets for the entire llm lifecycle—including synthetic data generation, augmentation, and post\-training workflows like sft and rlhf.
* proficiency in designing human\-in\-the\-loop labeling systems and proactively mitigating complex dataset failure modes such as label noise, bias, contamination, and distribution shift.
* demonstrated success using llms for data generation, model\-assisted labeling, and evaluation, with a focus on connecting iterative dataset changes to measurable improvements in model performance.
* strong technical foundation in distributed data processing frameworks (e.g., spark, ray, beam) and the ability to architect and deploy complex data engineering projects into production.
* a research\-engineering mindset that bridges the gap between experimentation and production, combined with communication skills to influence researchers, engineers, and product stakeholders.


why cisco?
  
  

at cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the ai era – and beyond. we’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. these solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. we work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
we are cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Senior Application Developer
description:
job description
  
  

at nyla, we are proud to deliver solutions that make a real impact! we’re seeking a dynamic, driven application developer to join our engineering team and build robust enterprise applications.
  
  

in this role, you will apply your knowledge and experience to extract and convey actionable insights at norad and usnorthcom office of the chief artificial intelligence officer (caio). as the senior application developer, you will design and deliver hardened data pipelines and analyses to inform ongoing operations and shape strategic roadmaps. you will serve as the cross\-functional bridge between multiple engineering and client leadership teams, partnering closely with nyla data scientists on the caio team to structure data science workflows and deliver high\-consequence operational tools that solve critical mission challenges! if you love solving technical challenges, pushing boundaries, and delivering scalable code, we’d love to connect!
  
  

the annual base salary range for this role is $170,000\-$230,000 (usd) , which does not include discretionary bonus compensation or our comprehensive benefits package. actual compensation offered to the successful candidate may vary from posted hiring range based upon geographic location, work experience, education, and/or skill level, among other things.
  
,
  
required skills
  
  

**core software development:** strong proficiency in python or javascript writing clean, maintainable, and scalable application code.infrastructure \& automation: experience with entry\-level to advanced infrastructure\-as\-code (iac), configuration\-as\-code, and ci/cd pipeline operations.
  
  

**api integration \& security:** familiarity with developing apis and integrating with api gateways, developing rest services, containerizing applications and/or microservices using docker or kubernetes, and container security and hardening baselines (such as ironbank).
  
  

**testing \& repository management:** hands\-on experience with unit testing frameworks and git\-based code repositories (such as github/gitlab).
  
  

education \& experience
  
**experience:** 4\+ years of experience delivering data and ai solutions for dow or ic customers
  
  

**education:** master’s degree in data science, computer science, statistics, information systems or a related field.
  
  

,
  
desired skills
  
  

demonstrated history of delivering high\-consequence mission\-enabling tools and solving complex operational road blocks.
  
implementing ai solutions that go beyond basic llm chat interfaces, such as integrating custom machine learning models or augmenting existing models with new data.
  
experience leading engineers on a technical delivery team, including requirements decomposition and ticket prioritization in a system such as atlassian jira
  
,
  
about nyla technology solutions
  
  

nyla technology solutions delivers exceptional artificial intelligence (ai), data science, and software engineering services for the u.s. government. nyla embraces a forward\-thinking and bold approach at every turn, earning us a solid reputation of technical trendsetters within the industry. we have a passion for developing solutions that have a quick and immediate impact on mission. headquartered in columbia, maryland, our customers love how we tackle their most challenging problems and get things done.
  
  

if you have the unique experience and expertise we are seeking, along with the desire and determination to invest your time and energy as a part of nyla’s team,
  
  

taking care of all of you
  
nyla provides a top\-of\-market compensation and benefits package. and through our unique nyla flex program, we custom tailor these benefits to best fit your lifestyle.
  
  

the nyla flex benefit program is designed to offer you flexibility in the 3 biggest areas of your life: your pay, your leave, and your schedule.
  
  

pay \- nyla starts with 4 weeks of annual leave plus 11 holidays and an additional day of annual leave for each year you’re at the company. you have the flexibility to cash out your annual leave hours, opt out of other nyla benefits, and/or arrange for additional hours on contract\* (over 40 hrs/week). there’s even an option to earn 1\.3 times your hourly rate once you work over 1880 hours on contract!
  
  

leave \- want to spend more time with the family? want more time to travel the world? you can buy additional annual leave for a total of 6 weeks of annual leave. that’s up to 240 hours of leave plus 11 holidays! that’s not even including paid anniversary leave!
  
  

schedule \- does the traditional 40\-hour workweek no longer fit your lifestyle? with nyla flex, you have the freedom to scale down to 30\-32 hours while still enjoying the top\-notch nyla benefits you know and love. it's flexibility that works for you without compromising the perks!
  
  

what about other benefits? nyla’s health care (medical, dental, and vision) is 100% covered by the company. we provide 10% 401k matching \- with full vesting day 1! our professional development offers $5,000 per year to be used towards fees, tuition, or time off for your continued growth. we even have a student loan repayment program and we provide 8 hours of volunteering annually so you can support your community, making your world a better place.
  
  

to learn more about nyla's culture and our exceptional benefit packages click here.
  
nyla is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Summer Associate Internship (Associate Data Engineer)
description:
the fraud data engineering team, within the fraud \& global security division, delivers reliable, scalable, and secure data solutions that power fraud detection, prevention, analytics, and decision\-making across navy federal credit union. our mission is to enable data\-driven fraud strategies by providing high\-quality data, modern data platforms, and engineering solutions that support fraud operations, fraud strategy \& reporting, fraud detection, fraud data science and machine learning models \& fraud investigation teams.


the summer associate will provide analytical and technical support to the fraud data engineering team by assisting with data integration, data quality, analytics, and platform modernization initiatives. the intern will gain hands\-on experience working with large\-scale fraud datasets, cloud technologies, and modern data engineering tools used to support critical fraud prevention and detection activities.
  

  

potential summer associate projects may include:


* assist in data readiness for ai use by supporting transformation, data quality, and accessibility efforts that enable ai and machine learning solutions.
* collaborate with data engineers, data scientists, fraud analysts, and business stakeholders on data\-driven projects.
* collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand business challenges and translate them into data\-driven solutions.
  

the summer associate program is a 12\-week internship program beginning in may 2027 and ending in august 2027 students will work on impactful projects and meaningful work during their internship. to qualify for this position, applicants must be currently pursuing a degree from an accredited college or university and have an anticipated graduation date of december 2027 or later.


  
responsibilities
  
* collaborate with engineers, analysts, and business partners to gather requirements and deliver solutions.
* assist in creating business requirement documents, build sttms, testing, and validating the fraud and security\-related data.
* enable real\-time and batch data integration across enterprise systems and external fraud data providers.
* support fraud business teams with timely, accurate, and actionable data solutions.
* analyze data to identify quality issues, trends, and opportunities for improving operational efficiency.
* document technical processes, data flows, and engineering solutions.
* participate in agile team activities, including planning sessions, standups, and project reviews.
* contribute to the development of databricks notebooks, enhance uat testing \& data validation framework.

  
qualifications
  
* currently pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, data engineering, data science, information systems, software engineering, analytics, or a related field.
* experience with programming languages such as python, sql, scala, java, or similar technologies.
* familiarity with relational databases, data warehousing concepts, and data modeling.
* basic understanding of etl/elt processes and data integration concepts.
* strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to work with large and complex datasets.
* knowledge of cloud platforms (azure, aws, or gcp) is preferred.
* familiarity with big data technologies such as databricks, spark, kafka, or hadoop is a plus.
* strong communication, collaboration, and technical presentation skills.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**our company**


optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. the work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, and data they need to feel their best. here, you will find a culture guided by diversity and inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits, and career development opportunities. come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health equity on a global scale. join us to start **caring. connecting. growing together.**

**position summary**


as an **ai solutions engineer** on the security operations and compliance (etosoc) team within enterprise security operations, you will build, automate, and modernize enterprise infrastructure solutions across both on\-premises and cloud environments. the etosoc team sits at the intersection of platform engineering, cloud operations, security compliance, and emerging ai technologies, ensuring critical systems remain resilient, secure, and operational at scale. in this role, you will design and deploy ai\-enabled solutions\-such as internal virtual assistants, automated compliance verification, and copilot\-driven development practices\-while building automation tooling across aws, azure, linux, windows, and modern web frameworks (react/fastapi).


you'll enjoy the flexibility to telecommute\* from anywhere within the u.s. as you take on some tough challenges.

**primary responsibilities:**

* design, develop, and deploy ai\-powered solutions, platform automations, and software applications to streamline workflows and address complex infrastructure challenges with an emphasis on responsible use of ai
* use enterprise\-approved ai tools to automate vulnerability remediation, patch compliance monitoring, and operational governance across enterprise scale
* evaluate emerging ai technology trends and platform capabilities to inform solution design, application architecture, and strategic engineering innovation
* build, modernize, and maintain full\-stack web applications and backend apis using react, fastapi, and python to support developer productivity and infrastructure operations
* develop infrastructure\-as\-code (iac) and configuration management tooling using terraform, chef, and github to automate server deployments and cloud resource provisioning
* collaborate closely with security, platform engineering, cloud operations, and compliance teams to translate complex security standards into automated verification and operational workflows


you'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear directions on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

**required qualifications:**

* 2\+ years of professional software engineering experience using languages such as python, javascript/typescript, java, or c\#
* 1\+ years of experience with cloud platforms (aws or azure) and infrastructure deployment tooling (e.g., terraform, chef, or ansible)
* 1\+ years of experience developing restful apis and web applications using modern frameworks (e.g., fastapi, react, node.js, or django)
* 1\+ years of experience using standard software engineering practices, git version control, and automated ci/cd deployment pipelines

**preferred qualifications:**

* bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, or a related technical field
* 1\+ years of experience designing, building, and deploying ai/ml integrations, internal ai assistants, or intelligent enterprise automations in production environments
* experience with ai\-assisted software development tools (e.g., github copilot) and llm application frameworks (e.g., langchain, openai apis)
* knowledge of infrastructure security, vulnerability remediation, patch management, or compliance frameworks (e.g., nist controls)
* experience integrating application data with enterprise cmdbs, monitoring tools (e.g., splunk, dynatrace), and itsm platforms (e.g., servicenow)
* experience working across multi\-os environments, including linux (rhel) and windows server infrastructure
* all telecommuters will be required to adhere to unitedhealth group's telecommuter policy.

  

pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. in addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). no matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far\-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. the salary for this role will range from $72,800 to $130,000 annually based on full\-time employment. we comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.

* integrate llms, enterprise tools, and applications through apis and workflow orchestration platforms.
* build proof of concepts (pocs), pilots, and reusable ai accelerators for enterprise adoption.
* create intelligent remediation and automation solutions to reduce manual effort across development and infrastructure teams.
* develop ai agents capable of performing multi\-step tasks, decision\-making, and workflow execution.
* collaborate with product, engineering, infrastructure, security, and operations teams to identify automation opportunities.
* establish best practices, governance, and reusable patterns for ai implementation.
* support enterprise modernization initiatives through ai\-enabled process transformation.
* measure and report productivity gains, efficiency improvements, and business outcomes.

* hands\-on experience with generative ai, llms, and ai agent frameworks.
* experience with langchain, langgraph, crewai, autogen, semantic kernel, or similar frameworks.
* strong understanding of prompt engineering, rag, vector databases, and ai workflow design.
* experience integrating enterprise applications using rest apis and sdks.
* knowledge of api integration, authentication, token management, and workflow orchestration.
* experience with automation platforms such as power automate, zapier, n8n, or similar.
* familiarity with cloud platforms (azure, aws, or gcp).
* experience with git, ci/cd pipelines, and software development best practices.
* strong problem\-solving and stakeholder communication skills.

**preferred qualifications**


* experience building enterprise ai agents and copilots.
* knowledge of development, infrastructure, security, or vulnerability remediation processes.
* experience implementing ai solutions for productivity improvement and process automation.
* understanding of enterprise architecture and system integration patterns.
* exposure to mlops, observability, and ai governance frameworks.

**expected outcomes**


* accelerate ai adoption across multiple technology organizations.
* deliver reusable ai frameworks and automation accelerators.
* reduce manual engineering effort through intelligent automation.
* enable faster experimentation, innovation, and enterprise transformation.
* drive measurable productivity and efficiency gains across teams.

**experience**


* 8\+ years of software engineering experience.
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in ai/ml, generative ai, or intelligent automation initiatives.
* prior experience leading enterprise automation or ai transformation initiatives preferred.

overview of role
  
  

the associate data \& ai analyst is a hands\-on member of the data and ai enablement team, responsible for designing, deploying, and maintaining ai\-driven data solutions that solve real business problems. the role works across the full solution lifecycle \- from data pipelines and lakehouse architecture through machine learning, large language models (llms), retrieval\-augmented generation (rag), and cloud\-hosted applications.

knowledge of traditional machine learning techniques such as classification, natural language processing, or sentiment analysis.
  
experience building data pipelines, performing etl, and working with lakehouse architectures such as microsoft fabric.
  
experience with microsoft azure, docker/containerization, web application deployment, and ci/cd practices.
  
understanding of vector databases and search technologies used in rag solutions.
  
ability to evaluate when ai\-based approaches are appropriate and when traditional solutions may be more effective.
  
strong analytical problem\-solving skills and the ability to translate stakeholder requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  
clear written and verbal communication skills with both technical and non\-technical audiences.
  
bachelor's degree in computer science, data science, data engineering, software engineering, information systems, mathematics, statistics, or a related technology or quantitative discipline.
  
  

preferred qualifications
  
  

experience with agentic ai architectures, multi\-step reasoning pipelines, or model context protocol (mcp).
  
experience with mlops practices such as model monitoring, versioning, and deployment pipelines.
  
familiarity with data governance, cloud security, and responsible ai practices.
  
experience with orchestration tools such as azure data factory.
  
ux or dashboard design sensibility for internal applications and kpi reporting.
  
experience working in a consulting or professional services environment.

sound judgment about the strengths, limitations, and responsible use of ai technologies.
  
a structured approach to solving complex and ambiguous business problems.
  
ability to balance model, data, and infrastructure considerations when designing solutions.
  
curiosity, adaptability, and a willingness to work across multiple parts of the modern data and ai stack.
  
strong collaboration skills and the ability to explain technical concepts and trade\-offs in practical business terms.

title: Senior Developer - Information Technology
description:
achieving our goals starts with supporting yours. grow your career, access top\-tier health and wellness benefits, build lasting connections with your team and our customers, and travel the world using our extensive route network.  

  

come join us to create what’s next. let’s define tomorrow, together.  

**description**
---------------


united's digital technology team is comprised of many talented individuals all working together with cutting\-edge technology to build the best airline in the history of aviation. our team designs, develops and maintains massively scaling technology solutions brought to life with innovative architectures, data analytics, and digital solutions.

 **job overview and responsibilities**


the senior developer will be responsible for the design, development, and evolution of united's ticketing platform. this role will lead the transition from legacy mainframe development approaches toward cloud\-native architecture and ai\-enabled, spec\-driven software engineering while delivering scalable solutions that support critical ticketing capabilities across the enterprise.


the ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong leadership, communication, and mentoring skills. this individual will partner with product to translate business outcomes into actionable solutions, collaborate with engineering and architecture on technical design, work with eqe to strengthen quality and automation, and coach developers as they grow their technical and professional capabilities.

* lead technical design phases by configuring ai agents to ingest product requirements documents (prds), business requirements, system architectures, and approved engineering standards.
* orchestrate agent workflows that transform high\-level business and technical artifacts into detailed, implementation\-ready specifications for microservices and platform capabilities.
* oversee the end\-to\-end design, development, documentation, testing, deployment, and support of backend solutions built on c\# and .net core.
* lead the decomposition of legacy mainframe ticketing capabilities into scalable, resilient, and cloud\-native services.
* design event\-driven architectures and communication patterns leveraging solace messaging technologies.
* define and govern api contracts, policies, security standards, and routing rules managed through kong api gateway.
* architect scalable, resilient, and secure infrastructure deployments across aws services, including ecs, eks, lambda, rds, and related cloud\-native technologies.
* maintain and enhance ci/cd pipelines using github actions and harness to automate build, testing, security validation, deployment, and release activities.
* continuously refine ai prompt pipelines, validation practices, and engineering guardrails to improve the accuracy, completeness, and quality of agent\-generated technical specifications.
* lead api integrations between internal platforms, external systems, and cloud services using api\-first design principles.
* collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate business capabilities into scalable technical solutions and delivery plans.
* partner with engineering, architecture, eqe, platform engineering, and operations teams to ensure solution quality, successful delivery, and operational readiness.
* facilitate technical discussions, design reviews, and architecture assessments, helping cross\-functional teams reach clear and timely decisions.
* highlight and document risks, issues, blockers, dependencies, and technical decisions while driving resolution plans with the appropriate stakeholders.
* mentor and coach developers in software engineering best practices, cloud\-native design, ai\-assisted development, technical problem\-solving, and software craftsmanship.
* foster a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, accountability, inclusion, collaboration, and innovation.
* champion quality engineering by partnering with eqe to improve automation, testability, reliability, and overall software quality throughout the development lifecycle.
* communicate complex technical concepts clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences, and build trusted relationships across the organization.
* stay current with industry best practices and emerging technologies in distributed systems, cloud engineering, api development, platform engineering, and ai\-enabled software delivery.
**qualifications**
------------------

### **what’s needed to succeed (minimum qualifications):**

* bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or related field preferred
* 3\+ years of experience in software development
* experience in the design, development, documentation, testing, and debugging of enterprise software systems
* deep expertise in c\# development, .net core, and advanced object\-oriented design principles
* strong experience designing and developing distributed systems, microservices, and api\-first architectures
* experience modernizing legacy or mainframe\-based applications into cloud\-native architectures
* production experience with enterprise integration technologies, including solace messaging and kong api gateway
* proven experience building cloud\-native applications and infrastructure on aws
* advanced experience with ci/cd automation tools, including github actions and harness
* hands\-on experience integrating ai coding agents, large language model workflows, or ai\-assisted engineering practices into the software development lifecycle
* strong understanding of spec\-driven development, technical documentation, and automated software delivery practices
* experience working within agile/scrum or safe frameworks and tools such as jira, confluence, or azure devops
* demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across product, engineering, architecture, eqe, platform engineering, and operations organizations
* strong verbal and written communication, stakeholder management, facilitation, and leadership skills
* experience mentoring developers and fostering technical and professional growth within engineering teams
* ability to influence without direct authority, navigate differing perspectives, and build alignment across cross\-functional teams
* strong analytical, problem\-solving, decision\-making, and organizational skills in a fast\-paced delivery environment
* must be legally authorized to work in the united states for any employer without sponsorship
* successful completion of interview required to meet job qualification
* reliable, punctual attendance is an essential function of the position

### **what will help you propel from the pack (preferred qualifications):**

* experience supporting airline ticketing, order management, reservation systems, passenger services systems, or related airline technology platforms
* knowledge of generative ai frameworks, prompt engineering, ai agent orchestration, and evaluation techniques
* proficient in python scripting for automation, data analysis, and operational tooling.
* experience leading adoption of emerging engineering practices and technologies
* experience serving as a technical mentor, coach, development lead, or facilitator of an engineering community of practice
* experience designing highly scalable event\-driven architectures and platform services
* familiarity with domain\-driven design (ddd), event sourcing, cqrs, and cloud\-native architecture patterns
* experience driving quality improvements in partnership with quality engineering teams
* agile experience

the base salary range/hourly rate listed is dependent on job\-related, factors such as experience, education, and skills. this position is also eligible for bonus and/or long\-term incentive compensation awards.  

  

you may be eligible for the following competitive benefits: medical, dental, vision, life, accident \& disability, parental leave, employee assistance program, commuter, paid holidays, paid time off, 401(k) and flight privileges.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**about perry weather**


perry weather is the weather safety standard for organizations that operate outdoors. we combine on\-site weather hardware with a software platform that automates alerts, siren activations, and safety decisions for more than 3,000 organizations — from the pga of america, the nfl, and mlb to turner construction, thousands of school districts, cities, and golf courses. we've grown 80%\+ annually for five consecutive years, and are continuing to grow.

  

we're headquartered in dallas at the centrum, in the oak lawn neighborhood, where our teams work together every day to help organizations make faster and safer decisions when weather puts people, assets, and operations at risk.

**about the role**


we're hiring our first data engineer to build perry weather's data platform from the ground up. you'll design the architecture, build it, and run it in production. you'll also be accountable for whether the company trusts and uses what you build.


today our operational data lives across azure sql server, timescaledb, and business systems including hubspot, zendesk, and acumatica. nothing unifies them yet. your job is to build the lakehouse and analytics platform that does, and to make it serve three things at once: executive decision\-making, internal ai workflows, and a new line of customer\-facing data products.


as the first hire on the data team, you set the architecture and the standards that later hires inherit. the bar is high. we want someone who has built a data platform from zero before, has strong opinions about how it should be done, and prefers an open mandate to a defined one.

**responsibilities**

* **own the data platform end to end.** architecture, ingestion, modeling, orchestration, testing, cost, and reliability. you make the build\-vs\-buy calls and stand behind them.
* **unify our operational and business systems.** bring azure sql server, timescaledb, hubspot, zendesk, acumatica, and sensor telemetry into one modeled, documented, queryable layer the company treats as the source of truth.
* **own data reliability.** data contracts, freshness and quality slas, lineage, observability, and the on\-call rotation behind them, so problems surface before they reach a dashboard.
* **build the foundation for our first data products.** our platform collects weather observations, sensor telemetry, environmental conditions, alerts, and operational events. you'll build the infrastructure that turns that into customer\-facing analytics, apis, benchmarking, and historical datasets, multi\-tenant and secure from the first release.
* **lead our ai data strategy.** build the pipelines and centralized datasets behind internal ai agents and llm workflows, and partner with department leaders to automate repetitive work. we want a real point of view on where ai creates durable value, grounded in systems thinking, not tool lists.
* **set the standard for the team that follows.** define how we model data, review changes, and document decisions. help us hire the next data engineers.
* **work directly with the business.** finance, revenue, cx, product, and the executive team. understand the decisions they're making and design for them.

**requirements**

* 7\+ years in data engineering, or backend engineering with deep data ownership.
* at least one cloud\-native data platform you designed, built from scratch, and operated in production yourself.
* enterprise\-scale data lake, lakehouse, or warehouse experience where you owned the schema, storage, and partitioning decisions.
* expert sql and dimensional modeling. you can design a model that survives a changing business and explain a metric definition to a non\-technical executive.
* strong software engineering fundamentals: version control, testing, ci/cd, code review, and infrastructure as code.
* reliable etl/elt across operational databases, imperfect saas apis, and telemetry streams.
* a track record supporting executive reporting where the numbers carried real consequences.
* hands\-on depth in a modern cloud data stack. synapse, databricks, or snowflake experience all count.
* fluency with ai\-native engineering tools and agentic workflows (e.g., terminal\-native coding agents, llm\-assisted code refactoring and data pipeline generation) to multiply technical output and speed up development cycles.
* a builder mindset: strategic enough to pick the right architecture, hands\-on enough to ship it. you do the work, not the work around the work.

**bonus points for** time\-series or geospatial data at scale; iot or sensor telemetry pipelines; streaming architectures (kafka, event hubs, flink); customer\-facing or monetized data products; dbt and modern orchestration tooling; and vertical software for physical, traditional, or safety\-critical industries.

**why perry weather**

* **you're building the foundation.** no legacy warehouse to work around and no team to inherit. you design the architecture that carries this company's analytics, ai, and data products for the next decade.
* **unusual data at real scale.** high\-frequency telemetry from 6,000\+ field\-deployed devices, weather observations, forecast intelligence, alerting events, and operational data from safety\-critical environments.
* **your work reaches customers.** this role shapes the next generation of our product portfolio, including products we haven't launched yet.
* **the mission is real.** perry weather exists to make everyone safer outdoors. every jobsite, high school, and public park is a safer place because of the systems you'll build.
* **room to build.** 80%\+ annual growth for five straight years, and the biggest opportunities are still ahead.
* **comprehensive benefits.** competitive health insurance plans, 401(k) with employer matching, and a suite of voluntary benefits, plus monthly all\-hands, lunch\-and\-learns, and a strong office culture in dallas's oak lawn neighborhood. this is an in\-office team five days a week.

**benefits**

* **you'll want to come into the office.** our oak lawn office isn't just a place to sit — it's where ideas move fast and culture stays strong. the whole team is here monday through friday, which means real collaboration, no chasing people down over slack, and a genuinely fun place to spend your work days.
* **your wellbeing is covered.** competitive health insurance, 401(k) with employer matching, and a full suite of voluntary benefits, because you shouldn't have to think twice about the basics.
* **good people, good times.** monthly all\-hands, office olympics, happy hours, and more. we take the work seriously and the culture seriously too.
* **you're getting in early, and that matters.** we're growing fast, but the biggest opportunities are still ahead. the people joining now will help shape what perry weather becomes.
